audit_rules: Both arms have zero scale events
Both arms use identical fixed-replica manifest
Checkpoint sidecar present and contract enforced
No candidate-coverage preflight failure among selected seeds
fresh_seed_rule: Take the first 8 topology seeds >=9301 that pass the replica-reachability preflight, before inspecting any policy outcome. Search at most 9340; report every rejected seed and reason.
parity_check: Final runner reproduced both opened 9106 weight-2 total RTTs bit-exactly: GNN 132346.20793916783 s; hand 143705.1737818597 s.
primary_metric: For each topology, mean task elapsed seconds for GNN seed divided by hand seed minus 1; aggregate the eight paired percentages by median.
purpose: Test whether the seed-1 bipartite GNN improves six-pass hand coordinate refinement when every policy sees the same fixed server replica set.
replica_pool_rule: For each task type and server, choose the compatible platform with minimum SHA-256 digest of 9106:task_name:node_name:platform_id; initialize every chosen platform; disable autoscaler scaling; require every client to reach a replica for every task type.
scope_limit: One fixed replica pool and one w0 burst workload; success does not establish dynamic-autoscaler or workload-window transfer.
success_rule: At least 7 of 8 topologies favor GNN, median elapsed reduction >=2%, and GNN including measured inference remains faster than hand including measured inference in at least 7 of 8. This is a one-sided sign-test p<=0.0352 plus an effect floor.
